_comment: THE SEARCH'S OWN T5 UNDER MTG_EDF_EXACT_EXECUTOR on claude_s9_gi8 (2026-09-14): the board the
autonomous arm reached after its T4 put BOTH Auras on one Conservatory. Seven mana on the board
(Mariposa {C}, Kitchen, Conservatory+Wild Growth+Overgrowth = 4, a bare Conservatory), Cloud of
Faeries already in play and unsick, and the hand holds the outlet (two Emiels), a Living Wish
and a Displacer. Cast Emiel for {2}{W}{W} and exactly {3} is left for the first blink; Cloud's
untap refunds 5 (the enchanted Conservatory + one more land) against a {3} activation, so the
loop is net +2 and unbounded; untapping Mariposa each pass banks the {C} that either wishable
finisher's {1}{C} activation needs. The recorded game (the search at d5/20 ms) cast Emiel AND the
Living Wish -- six of the seven -- and the real apply's own recogniser then read `ok=1 count=50`
on a board that could not pay the first {3}. So the frame asks the exact question the user put:
does the engine see that THIS board plus THIS hand goes off, and does its line actually kill?
